metadata.eligibility_summary: High school seniors with at least a 3.0 GPA, demonstrated financial need, planning to study STEM at a four‑year college, residing in Southern California Edison service area.
metadata.residency_restriction: Must live in, or attend a public or private high school in SCE’s service area or an eligible high school near San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station

evidence.award: The $1.2 million program awards $40,000 scholarships, paid over four years, to 30 high school seniors
evidence.eligibility: Applicants must have at least a cumulative 3.0 GPA, show financial need, and plan to pursue studies in the STEM fields

metadata.target_applicant_evidence: 30 high school seniors who either live in, or attend public or private high school, in SCE’s service area
metadata.stem_relevance_evidence: All are pursuing careers in STEM (science, technology, engineering or math)
